name: MultiExynoos
description: MultiExynoos Vulkan shim for Samsung Xclipse GPUs. Dual-mode: as an adrenotools/ARMSX3 driver pack this .so is dlopened and used as the single driver (standalone passthrough ICD: it self-loads the underlying driver and needs no VK_LAYER_LINK_INFO); as a loader layer it wraps the stock vulkan.samsung.so. Changes no behaviour.
author: MultiExynoos
